evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Small spatial VLMs acquire different abilities from their training: a model trained on large spatial question sets estimates object and room sizes well, whereas a model with a 3D geometry encoder is better at relative directions and absolute distances.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We propose SpatialDuet, which pairs a metric expert with a geometry expert under a Bayesian task router.
